column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4: Babel Archangel Revelation
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: To think you made it all the way up this long $$バベルの塔$$...
I have to say, that's quite an accomplishment!
Tch. Took us a little while, that's all.
Sure did! Maybe you just got here a liiittle too late!
After all, we've gathered all six suits of $$大天使の鎧$$,
and already finished our preparations to begin the true awakening!
But gathering the $$大神官$$ scattered all across the land and figuring out who was who...
That was an awful lot of work, you know!
After all, once an $$大天使$$ is reincarnated, until they reclaim their own armor...
they lose their $$記憶$$ and are reduced to ordinary $$大神官$$.
You must have realized it yourself already, haven't you?
Among the only seven $$大神官$$ in this $$世界$$...
only one $$大神官$$ remains...
Sir $$ヨハネ$$... You are the true reincarnation of Lord $$メフィスト$$!!
The very fact that the $$教皇$$ personally entrusted you with the armor of the $$大邪神$$
is proof beyond any doubt!
Everything you've done in this affair was part of it...
Bringing those cursed, dangerous people who could revive the $$大邪神$$ together in one place...
so you could crush them swiftly before they attained their true awakening. A magnificent plan...
Now, please come this way...
Let us reclaim that armor of $$メタトロン$$ together!!
Heh heh heh... Hahahahahaha...
Long ago, there were angels feared above all under the name of $$大天使$$...
beings possessed of tremendous magical power...!
At their head was the $$大天使$$ $$メフィスト$$, now the $$守護神$$ bearing black $$羽$$ and governing confidence and pride...
$$アダム$$'s first wife of old, the $$大天使$$ $$リリス$$, bearing black $$羽$$ and governing pleasure and $$怠惰$$!
The $$大天使$$ $$ベルゼブブ$$, supreme over all flying creatures, who governs ambition and $$嫉妬$$!
The $$大天使$$ $$ベヒーモス$$, commander of $$メフィスト$$'s navy, who governs hope and $$強欲$$!
The harvest god who demands $$生けにえ$$, the $$大天使$$ $$モーロック$$, who governs growth and $$暴食$$!
Originally a goddess of beauty, the $$大天使$$ $$ベルフェゴール$$, who governs $$恋$$ and $$欲情$$!
Ah... You are...!?
Ms. $$アスタルテ$$ from $$欲情$$ City, $$ベギルド$$...?
The raging god who brings about cataclysms, the $$大天使$$ $$アラストル$$, who governs concentration and resentment!
N-no way!?
Ah! Isn't that old man $$ケルビム$$ from the secret underground organization!?
So the former apostles of $$サタン$$ are all assembled at last! Wahahahahaha...
But then...
You don't even know who I am? You must not be very trusted by the $$教皇$$!
W-what did you say?!
I alone am the one who witnessed the $$創世記戦争$$ with these very eyes!
I have never been reincarnated, not once!
To begin with, you still call them the $$大邪神$$, but...
They lost that great war and came to be called $$大邪神$$...
the $$大天使$$ $$ミカエル$$, who governs $$正義$$.
the $$大天使$$ $$ウリエル$$, who governs $$自由$$.
the $$大天使$$ $$サリエル$$, who governs courage.
the $$大天使$$ $$ラグエル$$, who governs $$友情$$.
the $$大天使$$ $$ラファエル$$, who governs $$人権$$.
the $$大天使$$ $$ガブリエル$$, who governs $$愛$$.
And, of all the many $$大天使$$, the most mysterious $$大天使$$...
the $$大天使$$ $$メタトロン$$, who governs $$平等$$!!
At their origin, all of them were...
surely $$大天使$$ serving the same god!
And judging by your faces, you still have not grasped $$メフィスト$$'s true identity, have you?!
Even with this $$ルピルピ$$'s help...
I could not even restore the soul dwelling in $$メタトロン$$'s armor...
The notion that I am the reincarnation of $$メフィスト・フェレス$$ is laughable!
$$お師匠さま$$!!
Ghh...
(Then it isn't $$ヨハネ$$... it's that one...!?)
(Ugh... This feeling... Could it be from what I ate earlier to hasten my awakening...?)
(The $$知恵の実$$ is affecting me!?)
(Again... $$リリス$$'s $$記憶$$ from long ago...)
(No... I can't accept it! Because that means the seven...)
Hmph. Well, if you say so.
Even if you aren't Lord $$メフィスト$$'s reincarnation,
as long as we get $$メタトロン$$'s armor, it makes no difference...
Lady $$ルカ$$, I recommend that we meet them with the $$教団$$'s strongest $$邪道騎士$$.
Now that we know $$ヨハネ$$ is not one of us, we must make disposing of him our priority.
Mr. $$ケルビム$$!!
Heh heh heh...
With Lord $$メフィスト$$ absent now...
I'm sorry, but I cannot allow the $$創世記戦争$$ to happen again here!
(Why would Mr. $$ケルビム$$...?)
